entries.name: Pets challenge: tame 30 unique pets
entries.how: Life challenge. Pets have to look different to count: two identical-looking dogs of one breed count once. Taming 30 also fills the starting roster cap.
entries.unlocks: Counts toward the Life challenges trophy.

entries.name: Desert Cat
entries.how: West side of Varnia. Cats: pick it up with the carry button and pet it while carrying, then feed it. Pet it (+5 Trust, up to 5 times a day) and feed it meat (grilled +20, up to 3 a day) until Trust hits 100, then Take In. Takes at least 4 in-game days; resting skips 12 hours.

entries.name: Owl (rare)
entries.how: Night, ideally around 4:00. Best spots: high ground south of Scholastone Institute, south of the main route through Pororin, Three-Brothers Cliff (Delesyia), the outer ledges of Longbranch Shade Hideout (Pailune), Spire of Insight. Stock the perch with Tough Meat (Lean Meat as backup). Needs the Sotdae of Bond perch (Pororin Forest Guardians: Trembling Woods, Authorized Access). Place it, stock food, keep it stocked until Trust is 100, then Take In.
